描述_EN: trimmed at the bottom with green net and orange tassels. elaborate embroidery of celestial dragons, flaming jewels, birds, a large square panel at back and front in gold and copper thread showing a bird looking at an orange sun in beadwork. woman's sleeveless surcoat of embroidered silk satin, open all the way down front and sides. border round all edges of mauve and gold brocade. colours: blues, greens, gold, red, pink, yellow and white. towards the hem there are two dark blue ribbons fixing back and front together. stitches: satin, chinese knots, stem, long and short, split and couching.
描述_ZN: 底部用绿色的网和橙色的流苏进行修饰。 精心绣制的天龙、火焰珠宝、鸟类，在后面和前面用金色和铜线绣制了一个大的方形面板，显示了一只鸟在看一个橙色的太阳的珠子。 女子无袖绣花丝缎外衣，前面和两侧全部打开。 所有边缘有淡紫色和金色锦缎的边框。 颜色：蓝、绿、金、红、粉、黄、白。 在下摆处有两条深蓝色的丝带将后背和前面固定在一起。 针法：缎子，中国结，茎，长和短，分和合。
